title: Photo Booth Hire Hertfordshire | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Hertfordshire photo booth hire for weddings, corporate events and parties in Watford, St Albans, Stevenage and beyond. From £299. Get a free quote today.
intro: Hertfordshire sits at the heart of our service area, so wedding venues, golf clubs and corporate spaces from Watford to Royston see Boothdrop Entertainment booths every week. Packages begin at £299 and include a professional attendant, free delivery and setup, props and unlimited sessions during the hire.

sections.heading: What Hertfordshire planners book, and why
paragraphs: Hertfordshire weddings lean elegant, and the Magic Mirror matches that mood: a full-length interactive mirror with animations, games and a print for everyone in the shot, plus a guest book to take home. Golf club and hotel receptions around St Albans and Watford almost always have the 2m by 2m floor space and the ceiling height it needs, and the mirror photographs well against a smart function room.

The county's corporate scene is different. With film studios, business parks and head offices clustered around Borehamwood, Hatfield and Hemel Hempstead, brand activations and product launches often favour the GIF Booth, a digital-only pod that sends GIFs and boomerangs straight to guests by email or QR code with a custom animated overlay. The LCD SlimPod covers the broadest ground for birthdays, proms and staff parties, while the enclosed Party Booth is the pick for anyone who wants an old-fashioned curtain and some privacy for the sillier shots.
list: Magic Mirror: the wedding favourite for hotels and golf clubs
GIF Booth: digital-only, social-first, smallest footprint
LCD SlimPod: affordable touchscreen pod with prints and digital copies
Party Booth: enclosed curtain booth for up to 8 people

sections.heading: Practical notes on access and power in Hertfordshire venues
paragraphs: Hotels along the M25 and M1 corridors generally have a loading entrance, a goods lift and a function room with sockets on several walls, which keeps setup quick. Barns in the north of the county around Hitchin, Royston and Bishop's Stortford are often reached by a gravel track and may have one socket in the whole building; our attendant carries a long extension lead and a levelling base for uneven floors. First-floor rooms in older pubs and clubs are manageable by stairs for most models, though the Inflatable Booth is best kept at ground level.

We arrive 45 to 60 minutes before the hire window to build the booth, run test prints and lay out the props, and that time is never charged as hire. Marquee receptions need a reliable 13A supply within reach of the booth and a firm, dry floor beneath it.

sections.heading: Across the county, from Rickmansworth to Royston
paragraphs: Our regular Hertfordshire bookings include Watford, St Albans, Hemel Hempstead, Stevenage, Hatfield, Welwyn Garden City, Hitchin, Letchworth, Bishop's Stortford, Hertford, Ware, Cheshunt, Borehamwood, Potters Bar, Rickmansworth, Berkhamsted, Tring, Harpenden and Royston. The M25 and M1 bring us to the south and west of the county quickly, the A1(M) takes us up through Hatfield and Stevenage, the A41 serves Hemel Hempstead and Berkhamsted, and the A10 and M11 cover the eastern side around Ware, Cheshunt and Bishop's Stortford.

Being central to our service area, Hertfordshire travel is included in every package and the hire window is honoured in full, whatever the postcode. An evening booking in Potters Bar or Cheshunt is as straightforward for us as a daytime wedding in Harpenden, and the attendant plans the route around the usual M25 pinch points so the booth is ready on time.

sections.heading: Venue types we see most often in Hertfordshire
paragraphs: The south of the county is hotel and golf club country, with large function suites in and around Watford, St Albans, Rickmansworth and Potters Bar. The north and east are more rural, where converted barns, farm venues and village halls around Hitchin, Hertford and Bishop's Stortford host most of the weddings. In between sit school halls used for proms, community centres for birthdays and anniversaries, and the corporate venues and studios near Borehamwood and Hatfield that keep us busy with launches and Christmas parties.
For each of these, the booth needs a flat spot of at least 1.5m by 2m, a socket nearby and a position that guests will walk past on their way to the bar. We can advise from a floor plan or a photo.

sections.heading: Planning advice for weddings, proms and corporate events here
paragraphs: Wedding timing matters: start the hire window as the meal ends and run it through the evening reception, when guests are relaxed and ready to pose. If the venue has a separate evening guest list, make sure the booth is still live when they arrive. A personalised print template with names and the date is included and proofed in advance.

Prom season brings bookings from schools in Stevenage, Harpenden, Hitchin and the Watford area. Hotels and golf clubs are the usual venues, and we set up well before the students arrive. For corporate clients, we build a branded overlay with your logo, provide digital copies for internal comms and social media, and can add the green screen option on request. Birthday and anniversary parties in village halls tend to favour the SlimPod or the Party Booth, both of which run from one socket.

faqs.q: Where can your attendant park at a Hertfordshire golf club or hotel?
faqs.a: Most golf clubs and hotels in the county have ample parking and a service entrance for unloading. Our attendant will unload near the function room and then park where the venue directs. If the venue has any restrictions, please share them when booking and we will plan arrival accordingly.

faqs.q: Can you set up in a barn with a single socket or in a marquee?
faqs.a: Yes to both. For barns we bring a long extension lead and a levelling base for uneven floors. For marquees we need a reliable 13A supply, a flat dry surface and a position away from the entrance. Tell us what you have and we will recommend the right booth.

faqs.q: Are there travel fees for venues on the edge of Hertfordshire?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included for every Hertfordshire venue, from Rickmansworth to Royston. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue, it is shown on the quote up front, so you can budget with confidence before paying the deposit.

faqs.q: Do you supply booths for corporate launches near Borehamwood?
faqs.a: We do, and the GIF Booth is particularly popular for brand activations, with custom animated overlays and instant digital delivery by email or QR code. For awards dinners and Christmas parties, the Magic Mirror and LCD SlimPod with a branded print template are the more usual choices.

faqs.q: Is a first-floor function room a problem for the booth?
faqs.a: Not usually. Most of our pods and mirrors can be carried upstairs by the attendant where there is no lift. The Inflatable Booth is far better on the ground floor because of its size. Let us know the access and we will confirm which models suit the room.
